messages:
jamie: Heads-up — ACME Health (enterprise) just asked about feasibility for an on‑prem / air‑gapped POC. Key asks: signed installers, monthly security patches, SBOM, no egress, and a clearly defined upgrade cadence. Pricing/PS needed. Any immediate blockers?

maria: I can run the packaging checklist. couple quick Qs: do they require HSM-backed signing (customer HSM) or are we signing and delivering bundles? also: how big is their model surface (large LLM vs embedding service)?

jamie: They said model will be our quantized 7B + small feature store, so bundle ~5–8GB compressed. They want us to provide signed bundles; customer has offline HSM but will accept our signature if we provide key provenance.

alex: For 5–8GB minibundles we can do delta updates. We support two delivery modes: USB-sneakernet (physical media) or encrypted sftp with pre-shared certs via an airgap gateway. Both need signed manifests.

maria: Good. Proposed cadence options: 
- Weekly security micro-patch (hotfix) — only for CVEs
- Monthly cumulative minibundle (features + bugfixes)
- Quarterly full image refresh
Which one do they want to commit to?

jamie: Customer prefers monthly + emergency hotfixes. They explicitly asked for a 24–48hr hotfix window SLA for critical fixes. Can we meet that for Dedicated on-prem support?

alex: 24–48hr for signed minibundle prep + stamping is doable if we have a pre-approved release pipeline and CI that builds artifact + signs with our Notary. If customer requires customer-HSM signing, that adds manual steps and can push to 72hrs depending on logistics.

sam: Pricing note: monthly minibundles + 24–48hr hotfix SLA should be priced as an add-on. Suggest +20% on top of reserved capacity fee for guaranteed hotpatch window and expedited signing. also need PS days for onboarding (~8 days).

maria: Drafting a short runbook we can hand to ACME. quick packaging checklist draft:
```
- Produce signed minibundle (.tar.gz + manifest.json + signature)
- Include SBOM (CycloneDX) and sha256 checksums
- Provide delta patch generation script + apply instructions
- Offline activation token + replay protection
- Rollback instructions and verification steps
```
Can someone confirm we can auto-generate CycloneDX from our build system?

alex: Yes — build pipeline already emits SPDX and CycloneDX for hosted builds. We'll wire it into the minibundle job. Need to add a step to embed kernel/quantization metadata.

jamie: Security questionnaire item: they asked about key rotation frequency and attestation — they want a signed statement. security-bot, can we produce an artifact?

security-bot: I can generate a templated KMS/key-rotation statement. Items included: rotation cadence, signer identity, Notary chain, and step-by-step attestation process. I'll drop the doc to the thread in ~30m. :white_check_mark:

maria: Two operational concerns:
1) Delta bundle apply time on air-gapped infra — customers reported 15–30min apply for 8GB, need pre-checks.
2) Metrics/tracing: in an air-gapped POC we only get local logs; need to agree on what support traces we can accept via customers' sidecar.

jamie: I'll ask ACME for their maintenance window and the internal POC lead. Also ask whether they accept encrypted transfer vs physical media.

sam: Can we include a commercial option: 12‑month reserved + patching SLA + two onsite SRE days/month for the POC? Price anchor helps negotiation.

alex: Technical blocker to flag: if they insist on customer-side signing hardware on every update, we need network access (airgap shuttle) during the signing ceremony or a pre-signed pipeline with verifiable attestations. That impacts cadence and cost.

maria: Agreed. I'll put two proposals in the SOW: (A) Redwood-signed bundles + key-provenance doc (monthly cadence, 24–48h hotfix), (B) customer-HSM signing (monthly cadence, 72h hotfix + additional PS).

jamie: Perfect. Action items: @maria draft SOW + packaging runbook; @alex confirm CycloneDX embedding and delta tool perf; @security-bot drop the key-rotation attestation; @sam draft pricing add-on. I'll queue a call with ACME for tomorrow 10am PT.

maria: Got it — I'll post the draft SOW here when ready.

sam: I'll sketch pricing and PS estimate (ETA 2h).

alex: I'll run a quick delta apply test on an 8GB minibundle and report timings (ETA end of day).

security-bot: Attestation doc posted: https://redwood-internal/docs/attestation/acme-poc-rotation-v1 (internal)

jamie: Thanks team. If no other blockers, I'll confirm the call and request their POC checklist (maintenance window + POC lead). :thumbsup:
